blocks.text: IDEs (Integrated Development Environments) mukammal software suites hain jo software development ke liye tamam zaroori tools ek hi jagah dete hain. IDE mukhtalif development tools, jaise editors, compilers, debuggers aur version control systems, ko jor deta hai ta ke development ka process aasan aur tez ho. IDE ek hi interface deta hai jahan developers apna code efficiently likh, test aur debug kar sakte hain.

items: Eclipse: Java development ke liye bohat istemal hota hai.
Visual Studio: .NET aur C++ development ke liye mashhoor.
PyCharm: Python development ke liye pasand kiya jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Developers alag alag tools ki bajaye IDE kyun pasand karte hain?
blocks.explanation: IDE editor, compiler, debugger aur version control ek hi interface mein deta hai, is liye code likhna, chalana, test aur debug karna tez aur aasan hota hai.

items: IDE: tamam development tools ek jagah (editor, compiler, debugger, version control); Eclipse, Visual Studio, PyCharm.
